svg.title: Figure 8: Stage 8 typed entity canonicalization across 8 models
svg.desc: Two panels show task accuracy and raw PII output exposure across raw, random-masked, untyped, and typed representations across six local models, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and GPT-6.1 Sol.
svg.text: Figure 8 — Canonicalization eliminates raw-value exposure; accuracy effects vary by model
500 synthetic account-resolution examples per model (16,000 generations across six local models plus Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol); citations disabled.
Panel B: Outputs exposing raw personal data (%)
Raw = literal names, emails, account numbers. Random = arbitrary alphanumeric mask.
Key finding: Typed handles improved accuracy in four of six local models (two ceiling-limited); Sonnet and Sol were saturated (≥99.8%).

text: Panel B: Outputs exposing raw personal data (%)
Raw = literal names, emails, account numbers. Random = arbitrary alphanumeric mask.
Key finding: Typed handles improved accuracy in five of six local models; Sonnet was saturated and showed no gain.
Data boundary: Every masked representation reduced raw-value output exposure to 0.0% across all seven models.
Sample size: 500 paired semantic examples per model; 14,000 generations in total.
